integrity: Exact symbolic proof with standalone finite-field corroboration. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns smooth monic quintic cyclic-trigonal presentations with distinguished infinity over algebraically closed characteristic-two fields. It does not classify full Ekedahl-Oort types, Newton polygons, unmarked curves, or individual automorphism strata. The constancy of a-number and abstract properties of the rank-zero moduli stratum are established prior work; historical priority for the explicit coefficient formula is provisional.
title: An explicit 2-rank divisor in the genus-four cyclic trigonal family
